invariants.description: second law: every reaction runs down its affinity, v A >= 0, so P_diss >= 0
invariants.expr: np.all(v_PYRC*A_PYRC >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PYRC).max()*np.abs(A_PYRC).max()) and np.all(v_PIC*A_PIC >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PIC).max()*np.abs(A_PIC).max()) and np.all(v_ANT*A_ANT >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_ANT).max()*np.abs(A_ANT).max()) and np.all(v_PDH*A_PDH >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PDH).max()*np.abs(A_PDH).max()) and np.all(v_CS*A_CS >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_CS).max()*np.abs(A_CS).max()) and np.all(v_ACO*A_ACO >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_ACO).max()*np.abs(A_ACO).max()) and np.all(v_IDH*A_IDH >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_IDH).max()*np.abs(A_IDH).max()) and np.all(v_OGDH*A_OGDH >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_OGDH).max()*np.abs(A_OGDH).max()) and np.all(v_SCS*A_SCS >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_SCS).max()*np.abs(A_SCS).max()) and np.all(v_CII*A_CII >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_CII).max()*np.abs(A_CII).max()) and np.all(v_FUM*A_FUM >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_FUM).max()*np.abs(A_FUM).max()) and np.all(v_MDH*A_MDH >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_MDH).max()*np.abs(A_MDH).max()) and np.all(v_CI*A_CI >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_CI).max()*np.abs(A_CI).max()) and np.all(v_CIII*A_CIII >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_CIII).max()*np.abs(A_CIII).max()) and np.all(v_CIV*A_CIV >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_CIV).max()*np.abs(A_CIV).max()) and np.all(v_ATPS*A_ATPS >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_ATPS).max()*np.abs(A_ATPS).max()) and np.all(v_LEAK*A_LEAK >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_LEAK).max()*np.abs(A_LEAK).max()) and np.all(P_diss >= -1e-9*np.abs(P_diss).max())

invariants.description: conserved moieties (relative 1e-9): NAD+ + NADH, CoA + acetyl-CoA + succinyl-CoA, matrix ATP + ADP, Q + QH2, cytochrome c, and the TCA cycle's intermediates (citrate to oxaloacetate)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(C_NAD_m + C_NADH_m, (C_NAD_m + C_NADH_m)[0], rtol=1e-9, atol=0) and np.allclose(C_CoA + C_AcCoA + C_SucCoA, (C_CoA + C_AcCoA + C_SucCoA)[0], rtol=1e-9, atol=0) and np.allclose(C_ATP_m + C_ADP_m, (C_ATP_m + C_ADP_m)[0], rtol=1e-9, atol=0) and np.allclose(C_Q + C_QH2, (C_Q + C_QH2)[0], rtol=1e-9, atol=0) and np.allclose(C_cytc_ox + C_cytc_red, (C_cytc_ox + C_cytc_red)[0], rtol=1e-9, atol=0) and np.allclose(C_Cit + C_Icit + C_OG + C_SucCoA + C_Suc + C_Fum + C_Mal + C_OAA, (C_Cit + C_Icit + C_OG + C_SucCoA + C_Suc + C_Fum + C_Mal + C_OAA)[0], rtol=1e-9, atol=0)

invariants.description: the ports report each chemostat's net production: j_O2 = -v_CIV, j_Pyr_c = -v_PYRC, j_ATP_c = v_ANT, j_CO2 = v_PDH + v_IDH + v_OGDH (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(j_O2, -v_CIV, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_Pyr_c, -v_PYRC, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ATP_c, v_ANT, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_CO2, v_PDH + v_IDH + v_OGDH, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30)

bc_sweep.rationale: O2 from near anoxia to air-saturated; ATP and ADP from a de-energised to a resting cell; phosphate, pyruvate and CO2 over an order of magnitude; cytosol pH 6.8 to 7.6, matrix 7.4 to 8
